claims.claim: Converged repository-owned execution-profile policy and provider-neutral profile contract on one deterministic specification preserving TASK-061 defaults.
Codex and Antigravity adapters consume injected profile values across PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR command construction without duplicating policy.
Focused regression coverage validates synthetic future model identifier and effort reach native command construction while invalid effort fails closed.
Every canonical Codex and Antigravity native invocation binds and persists an immutable execution-profile sidecar before runner entry, and mismatches fail closed before invocation.
Profile persistence is idempotent for identical content and fails closed on conflicting content, preserving provenance after native execution.
Terminal transport verifies execution profile presence and content idempotently when expected, while historical terminal artifacts without profiles remain valid.
No-native-invocation flows create no misleading execution-profile artifacts and Antigravity MiniMax semantics remain unchanged.
CLI, carrier, and dispatch selection semantics remain unchanged with production defaults preserved at gpt-5.6-sol/high and gemini-3.8-flash/high.
Kernel lifecycle, verification, review, and publication authorities remain unchanged.
